title: Project gap and knowledge writes need a first-class checkout-owner mutation lane
wanted_capability: An agent on a checkout host can file or mutate repo-owned project gaps and knowledge entries through a first-class tool, with the write landing in the repo's committed .bbox/ state and flowing to the daemon via the collector publication. Today the daemon refuses covered-project writes by design (error.knowledge_transport_authoritative) and the only lanes are hand-authoring gap-<id>.json / knowledge files and committing them, which agents get wrong (wrong schema, missing commit, uncommitted strays).
fallback_used: Hand-write the committed .bbox/gaps/gap-<id>.json record (or .bbox/knowledge/ entry) on the checkout host and commit it; the collector publishes on its next cycle.
evidence: agent report 2026-08-11: bbox_gap(scope=project) failed with attachment_inactive (ordering bug, fixed in 9a2a1af7); the intended refusal reveals the missing lane
notes: The .bbox/gaps/inbox/ file-drop spool does not work on the zero-authority estate: spool import moves files through checkout access, which needs local fs, and the collector publishes only committed .bbox/gaps/*.json records. Candidate shapes: a collector subcommand (bbox-code-collector gap-file) that validates and writes the record, a bro CLI verb, or a producer-backchannel mutation endpoint mirroring catalog onboarding. sm-gap-notes still teaches the inbox lane, which is bridge-era guidance.
resolution_note: implemented in 58cb98c3 + 5813cb0c + 8e6f2b4a: the checkout-mutation backchannel (daemon validates/mints/enqueues exact .bbox file bytes; collector poll/apply/ack) covers project gap file/update/resolve and knowledge learn/remember/decide/forget via the original MCP tools. Live-proven 2026-08-12: gap-b404ab83 filed via bbox_gap on a covered project, delivered by the collector in seconds. Knowledge updates and bbox_knowledge_link on covered project entries still fall to manual file edits; that residue is smaller than the filing lane this gap tracked.
